name: Pilgrims
overview: Scripture presents pilgrims as those called by God to leave their familiar surroundings and trust His guidance toward an unknown land, exemplified by Abram's obedience to God's command to depart from his country (Genesis 12:1). This journey requires a wholehearted commitment that may involve renouncing close relationships and personal comforts to follow Christ faithfully (Luke 14:26). Believers are reminded that, as pilgrims not of this world, they are chosen by God and may face opposition from the world (John 15:19), yet they are sustained by God's Word, which lights their path (Psalms 119:105), and assured of eternal life through faith in Jesus Christ (John 3:16). The joyful observance of God's appointed times, such as the Feast of Tabernacles (Leviticus 23:40), reflects a pilgrim's heart rejoicing in God's provision and promises along the journey.
